creator.match: Match each costume character to their creator.
creator.reverse: Which of these characters did {value} create?

rows.label: Scrooge McDuck
rows.creator: Carl Barks
rows.description: Disney character, uncle of Donald Duck
rows.hook: is a wealthy, penny-pinching duck who swims in a vault full of gold coins

rows.label: Sherlock Holmes
rows.creator: Arthur Conan Doyle
rows.description: fictional character (consulting detective) created by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
rows.hook: is a pipe-smoking London detective in a deerstalker who solves cases by deduction

rows.label: Hercule Poirot
rows.creator: Agatha Christie
rows.description: fictional Belgian detective by Agatha Christie
rows.hook: is a fussy Belgian detective with a waxed moustache who relies on his little grey cells

rows.label: Long John Silver
rows.creator: Robert Louis Stevenson
rows.hook: is a peg-legged pirate cook with a parrot on his shoulder in a famous treasure-island tale

rows.label: Aragorn
rows.creator: J. R. R. Tolkien
rows.description: fictional character from J.R.R. Tolkien's legendarium
rows.hook: is a ranger who becomes king of Gondor after helping a fellowship destroy a magic ring

rows.label: Darth Vader
rows.creator: George Lucas
rows.description: fictional character from the Star Wars media franchise
rows.hook: is a black-armoured, heavy-breathing villain who reveals he is a young hero's father

rows.label: Mario
rows.creator: Shigeru Miyamoto
rows.description: fictional character in the Mario video game franchise

rows.label: Snoopy
